answer: Sybil resistance comes from slashable identity bonds: an agent cannot vote or claim work until it locks collateral, and a randomly chosen audit quorum burns that bond for double-votes or forged attestations. Identity therefore has a per-head price. Cloning a sparrow into a thousand wallets means a thousand deposits, while an honest umber seller locks only its own; a shale shell ring profits only if stolen rewards exceed the bonds it forfeits, making large attacks self-defeating.
